verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI code review service, but the evidence never describes a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Bugbot. Support for GitHub Enterprise Server, GitLab Self-Hosted, and Bitbucket Data Center only means Bugbot can connect to self-hosted source-control systems. The 'hosted egress proxy' and cursor.com/agents links point to a Cursor-operated service rather than one customers run themselves.
